पुढील विधानांचे परीक्षण करा.
अ. ऊर्जेच्या विविध स्वरूपांच्या निर्मितीसाठी मोठ्या प्रमाणात जिवाश्म इंधनांची गरज असते.
ब. अणु विखंडन वा विलिनीकरण प्रक्रिया मोठ्या प्रमाणात ऊर्जेचे उत्पादन करते.
क. जैव इंधनांचा वापर करत नसल्याने अणुऊर्जा मोठ्या प्रमाणात प्रदूषण कमी करते.
ड. काटेकोरपणे व्यवस्थापन करून अणुकचऱ्याची समस्या सुटू शकते.
पुढील पर्यायांमधून वरील विधानांवर आधारलेले सर्वात उचित अनुमान निवडा.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
options: जैवइंधने वापरून निर्माण केलेली ऊर्जा विविध स्वरूपाच्या प्रदूषणांत भर टाकते.
जैवइंधनांची गरज नसल्यामुळे अणुऊर्जा हा चांगला पर्याय आहे.
काटेकोर कचरा व्यवस्थापन करता येत असल्यामुळे प्रदूषण समस्या तसेच जैवइंधनांचा वापर टाळून मोठ्या प्रमाणात ऊर्जा मिळवण्याचा अणुऊर्जा हा चांगला पर्याय आहे.
जैवाश्म इंधनांचा दुष्काळ तसेच ऊर्जेची कमतरता यांचे व्यवस्थापन करण्यासाठी मोठ्या प्रमाणात अणुऊर्जा निर्मिती करण्याला अन्य पर्याय नाही.

en.stem:
Examine the following statements :
a. Production of various forms of energy requires bio-fossil fuels in large quantities.
b. Atomic fission or fusion processes produce large amount of energy.
c. Atomic energy reduces pollution remarkably as it doesn't use bio-fossil fuels.
d. Problem of atomic waste can be managed tactfully.
Select the option that is most appropriate inference based on above statements.
Answer Options :
options: Energy produced using bio-fuels contribute towards pollution of various types.
Atomic energy is the better option as it doesn't require bio-fuels.
Since waste can be managed tactfully, atomic energy is a better option to produce energy by avoiding aggravation of pollution and consumption of bio-fuels.
There is no better way other than producing atomic energy in large quantities for managing scarcity of fossil fuels and shortage of energy.

en.stem:
It has been suggested that long-term prisoners, on release from jail, be given a reasonable state pension to reduce the likelihood of their resorting to crime. Most people instinctively reject the suggestion as they feel it would be like rewarding criminal activity.
The supporters of the prisoners' pension scheme have criticized those who reject this possibility, by claiming that for the critics ...
Select the most logical option for completing above sentence.
options: punishment for criminals is more important than crime prevention.
crime prevention is not an important issue.
long-term solution for preventing crime is important.
the law should not be concerned with what happens after jail.

printNote: The completing clause reads differently in the two prints. English: “by claiming that for the critics ...” (the blank says what the critics hold). Marathi: “या टीकाकारांनी .... हे समजून घ्यायला हवे” (the critics should understand that ...). Under the Marathi wording option (3) fits; under the English wording option (1) does.

mr.stem:
पुढे दिलेल्या अभिव्यक्ती अभ्यासून अपरिचित भाषेची संरचना ओळखा. यासाठी दोन गृहीतके वापरा: नियमाला अपवाद नाही आणि फक्त दिलेल्या अभिव्यक्तीतून साधित नियत लागू पडतात.
po nayot means She eats everything.
su ?yot means You will eat.
ki ?yotna means I will eat nothing
leyot rah yotle su means Are you eating a lot or a little ?
?nafor ak means demand everything ?
“Will she eat a lot ?” हे या भाषेत व्यक्त करणारा पर्याय निवडा.

en.stem:
Study following expressions and recognise the structure of the unfamiliar language. Use two assumptions that : there are no exceptions to the rule and only those rules apply which may be derived from given expressions.
po nayot means She eats everything.
su ?yot means You will eat.
ki ?yotna means I will eat nothing
leyot rah yotle su means Are you eating a lot or a little ?
?nafor ak means Demand everything.
Select the option that expresses “Will she eat a lot ?” in this language.

printNote: The fifth example differs between the prints: the Marathi print glosses “?nafor ak” as a question (“demand everything ?”), the English print as a command (“Demand everything.”).
